purpose: test whether explicit current-month visible-target context closes the gap to tabular baselines
visibility: context features use only labels visible under the fit or final-prediction role; own target is excluded from global summaries

pass_rules.primary: mean MAE improves at least 5 percent over the 30-epoch reference for at least two analyte-by-mask families
pass_rules.scenario: DOC or specific conductance improves at least 5 percent in at least one temporal family
pass_rules.no_harm: no tested family worsens by more than 3 percent
pass_rules.shuffle: a context-shuffle diagnostic must reduce performance before context is treated as used information
